prompt: Solve for $x$: $7x - 4 = 3x + 16$. Give just the number.
hint: Move all the $x$'s to one team first: subtract $3x$ from both sides.

hints.text: Move all the $x$'s to one team first: subtract $3x$ from both sides.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a balance scale
steps: Left pan: 7 boxes with 4 grams removed. Right pan: 3 boxes plus 16 grams.
Lift 3 boxes off each pan, then add 4 grams to each pan: 4 boxes balance 20 grams.
